as_told.title: Plasma orbs at a heart-centred event with 30 people

plain: A man named Jordan Jose tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a group session he says took place in 2024 at the Esalen Institute, a retreat center in Big Sur, California, where people tried to make contact with something beyond us. He says that blue glowing balls, which he calls plasma orbs, rose out of the ocean and came within about 50 yards of people. He mentions a man named Ross Coulthart in connection with it. Later in the same interview he describes the event again without naming the place, saying about 30 people were there, all very heart-centered, and they had incredible interactions with the orbs. Jordan is the only teller, speaking twice in one conversation. If true, it would mean a group can call such lights in just by their shared state of mind.
